workspace.scope: Head, both arms (-25..95 deg, 90=down, 0=forward, -29=up limit), in-place base twist only (no linear driving).

settings.method: multiband spectral flux + autocorrelation + robust beat-grid fit
settings.origin: estimated beat origin; four-beat blocks are not detected downbeats

legacy_result.method: multiband spectral flux + autocorrelation + robust beat-grid fit

settings.scope: offline known audio analysis; online motion generation is separate

metric_configuration.accent_detector: peaks of mean squared joint-range-normalized velocity

sample_timing: music_time uses source host-monotonic receipt mapped to music clock; observed_monotonic is polling time; transport delay remains included
synchronization_scope: estimated beat reference and host receipt timing; not acoustic ground truth

adapter_capabilities.feedback_timestamp: host monotonic reception; robot created timestamp retained but not clock-synchronized
adapter_capabilities.completion: HTTP acceptance is NOT motion completion
